limits: Local KV operation contract only, not SQL or production durability equivalence

postgres.version: Official portable PostgreSQL 18.4 binaries with recorded hashes.
postgres.durability: fsync=on, full_page_writes=on, synchronous_commit=on; serializable session transactions.
postgres.cache: 64 MiB shared_buffers plus work_mem and OS cache. Not an equal-memory embedded comparison.
postgres.maintenance: VACUUM ANALYZE and CHECKPOINT as separate messages; not full compaction.
postgres.reopen: Client reconnect, NOT server restart or crash recovery.
postgres.physical_scope: Table+index+TOAST relation lengths only; cluster/WAL totals reported separately.
postgres.qualification: Prepared BYTEA operations over authenticated loopback TCP on a new owned cluster. Transport is included; report separately from embedded calls.
